data.name: Chiggas - Survival of the Mitiest
data.detailed_description:
Survival of the Mitiest Begins


Chiggas: Survival of the Mitiest is a fast, chaotic arcade survival game where one Chigga Player stands against waves of hungry enemies, dangerous bosses, and escalating stage threats. Run, munch, shoot, recruit, boost, and survive as long as you can while building your army of Chigga Soldiers and proving who is truly the mitiest.

Fight, Munch, Recruit, Survive


Every run starts simple, but survival does not stay easy for long. Enemies swarm from every direction, stages become more dangerous, and the pressure keeps rising. Pick up weapons, grab speed boosts, munch when you need to recover, and recruit Chigga Soldiers to help turn the fight in your favor.

  • Survive escalating stages filled with enemies, hazards, and boss encounters.
  • Recruit Chigga Soldiers to grow your squad and fight back against the swarm.
  • Pick up weapons like pistols and rifles to blast through enemies.
  • Use powerups including speed boosts that help you escape, chase, and survive.
  • Munch to stay alive when the pressure gets intense.
  • Unlock Chigga Wear and customize your look with Legendary cosmetic items.

Build Your Mity Run


Each run challenges you to react fast and make the most of what you find. A weapon pickup can turn a desperate escape into a comeback. A speed boost can save you from being surrounded. A recruited Chigga Soldier can help you push deeper into the chaos.

Legendary Chigga Wear


Survival is important, but looking legendary matters too. Unlock and equip Chigga Wear to give your Chigga Player a unique style. Legendary Chigga Wear adds premium cosmetic flair without changing the core survival challenge.

Key Features


  • Fast arcade survival gameplay
  • Stage-based progression
  • Recruitable Chigga Soldiers
  • Weapon pickups and ammo-based shooting
  • Speed boosts with high-impact movement
  • Munch-based survival moments
  • Boss fights and escalating enemy pressure
  • Unlockable Chigga Wear and Legendary cosmetics
  • Steam achievements for major milestones

Prove You Are the Mitiest


Whether you are chasing a longer survival time, unlocking new achievements, recruiting your first Chigga Soldier, or building the perfect Legendary fit, every run gives you another chance to push farther.

How long can you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10 64-bit
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4300 or better
  • 메모리: 4 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or better
  • 저장 공간: 500 MB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • 추가 사항: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Keyboard/mouse supported. Internet connection required for Steam purchases, inventory sync, and store features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
권장:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • 메모리: 8 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD Graphics 620 or better
  • 저장 공간: 1 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • 추가 사항: SSD recommended. Internet connection recommended for Steam inventory, purchases, and future content updates.
